INTERNAL SIMULATED NOTICE — PENDING REVIEW
Fictional demo data. This illustrative template is not legally vetted or ready to serve.

Prepared on: 2026-09-12
Reviewer: Monad testnet demo reviewer
Property: Juniper Court · fictional portfolio
Address: 100 Example Lane, Los Angeles, CA · fictional address
Unit: 04
Resident: Demo Resident 04

PROPOSED NOTICE TEXT
Dear Demo Resident 04,
We are proposing to increase the monthly base rent for Unit 04 at Juniper Court · fictional portfolio from $2,000.00 to $2,040.00, effective 2026-10-13. This is a monthly increase of $40.00 (2%).
[Insert reviewed mandatory notice language, issuer details, and applicable attachments before final approval.]

INTERNAL REVIEW NOTES
Proposed monthly base rent: $2,040.00
Current monthly base rent: $2,000.00
Proposed monthly change: $40.00 (2%)
Candidate effective date: 2026-10-13
Lease end: 2026-10-12; recorded last increase: 2025-10-13

Manager instruction: 2%. The reviewed ordinary ceiling is 3% ($2,060.00 base rent), a limit rather than a pricing instruction.
This calculation excludes separate permitted charges and special adjustment approvals. No utility percentage is added.

Source: LAHD · LA City RSO ordinary annual adjustment, 2026–2027
Source URL: https://housing.lacity.gov/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/Allowable-Rent-Increase-Bulletin-English.pdf
Rule period: 2026-07-01–2027-06-30; source checked: 2026-09-12
